sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P1 面墙靠墙倒立保持）

purpose.zh: 练倒立时直臂顶肩和身体一条线，为托马斯倒立类动作打底
purpose.en: Builds a locked, tall-shoulder handstand line against the wall.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往上顶，耳朵在两臂中间
text.en: Arms locked, push tall through your shoulders, ears between your arms

text.zh: 胸口和肚子朝墙，手离墙一拳，手指朝墙。
text.en: Chest and belly face the wall, hands about a fist away, fingers toward the wall.

text.zh: 收紧肚子和屁股，从手到脚尖一条线，别塌腰。
text.en: Brace your belly and glutes, one line from hands to toes, no arched back.

text.zh: 先练爬墙到一半；累了随时侧翻或沿墙走下来。
text.en: Start by walking halfway up; whenever you are tired, cartwheel out or walk back down.

commonErrors.zh: 塌腰，肚子贴墙、腰往前凸
commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back toward the wall.

commonErrors.zh: 肩没顶开，头伸到两臂外面
commonErrors.en: Shoulders not fully open, head poking out past your arms.

cautions.zh: 先学会侧翻或走下墙的退出，再倒立；手腕或肩疼就停；高血压、青光眼等不宜倒立
cautions.en: Learn the exit before you go up; stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt; skip inversions with high blood pressure or glaucoma.

flare2.item: P1 面墙靠墙倒立保持
flare2.plans: 2 个计划（三角肌中级；阶段 11/15 中级）
flare2.camera: 侧面偏背后 19°（看身体线和肩是否打开）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 20 秒、休 60 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): static chest-to-wall hold only (set -> push tall -> hold ~5.7 s); the walk-up / exit (表：有下墙退出示意) is not animated, only in the cues.

set.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往上顶，身体一条线
set.en: Arms locked, push tall, one straight line
